About.bio_lead: I design and build reliable software that keeps high-traffic business operations running smoothly.
About.bio_body: Over the past 3+ years, I've architected and shipped full-stack web applications, distributed background workers, and enterprise e-commerce systems. My approach centers on clean architectural boundaries, predictable database performance, and interfaces that are fast and pleasant to use.

principles.p1_desc: Bounded query execution, proper indexing, and offloading heavy work to asynchronous queues.
principles.p2_desc: End-to-end type safety, from database models to frontend components.
principles.p3_desc: Defensive error handling, structured logging, idempotent APIs, and zero-downtime deployments.

items.q1: What's your primary stack for new projects?
items.a1: For most modern products, I use Next.js 16 (React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind) on the frontend, paired with NestJS/Node.js services, PostgreSQL via Prisma/TypeORM, Redis for caching and queues, and Docker for reproducible deployments.
items.q2: Do you handle projects from the ground up?
items.a2: Yes. I lead projects from initial architecture and database design through frontend implementation, API development, and deployment with CI/CD.
items.q3: How do you ensure performance under load?
items.a3: By offloading heavy work to background queues (BullMQ/Redis), optimizing query execution with proper indexing, applying targeted caching, and load-testing endpoints before they ship.
items.q4: Are you available for contract or full-time work?
items.a4: Yes — I'm currently available for select engineering contracts, consulting, and full-stack development roles.
